title: Email verification: Mailpit provider + docker-compose + pluggable interface
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose.yml runs Mailpit (SMTP + REST API) inside the project
Pluggable email-provider interface; Mailpit provider polls the REST API for the newest message to the generated (plus-addressed per run) address
Extracts verification link OR OTP code from the message; auto-detects 'check your email' / 'enter code' states and completes the step
Unit tests for email link extraction and OTP parsing on fixture messages; pytest green
The email e2e SKIPS with a clear message when Mailpit/Docker is unreachable (does NOT hang); verified now since Docker daemon is DOWN

Docker is UP now: bring up Mailpit via docker compose and perform a REAL fetch from its REST API in an integration test (not skipped). Keep skip-cleanly ONLY as fallback for when Docker is genuinely unreachable.
